game.title: Alice: Madness Returns
game.build_notes: Verified 2026-09-04 dev PC, windowed 1280x720, with our d3d9.dll proxy present. Driven by external synthetic keyboard (SendInput scancodes) for menus and the proxy's own F-key hotkeys for stereo. MUST be windowed (see hazards). Re-verified 2026-09-07 (dev PC): full menu->gameplay drive, character movement, all six proxy hotkeys, and a graceful self-close, all unassisted after the user's launch. Harness: alice-madness-returns-vr/dev-archive/tools/alice_harness.py.

input.api: Win32 SendInput (scancode keyboard) for menus; proxy F-key hotkeys (GetAsyncKeyState, polled each Present) for stereo controls
api_notes: The window title is 'Alice Madness Returns' (match substring 'Alice').

MUST run windowed: Fullscreen=True gives fullscreen-exclusive which BitBlt captures as solid black, so the harness cannot see or drive it. Set Fullscreen=False in the live config while the game is CLOSED (UE3 rewrites config on exit). [verified-live 2026-09-04]
Menus take Enter / arrow keys / Esc. Some menu screens are radial (Configuration categories arranged around a head; Left/Right/Down move between them) while others are vertical lists.

The proxy's stereo hotkeys are read via GetAsyncKeyState in the Present hook: F9 toggle stereo, F10 swap eye, F11/F12 ipd -/+, F7/F8 convergence. F9 confirmed to register from external SendInput 2026-09-04. Their effect is logged to Binaries\Win32\alice_vr_proxy_log.txt.
Capture with BitBlt from the screen DC, window focused first.

bindings.action: move the menu selection (vertical lists and radial category menus)
bindings.notes: In a yes/no dialog, Left=NO, Right=YES (dialogs default to NO). In the Video sliders, Left/Right change the highlighted row's value.

bindings.action: back out of a menu / open the in-game pause menu
bindings.notes: Esc in a settings sub-screen raises a 'Cancel? All changes will be lost' dialog (NO default).
Logs 'HOTKEY F9: stereo ON/OFF (... p00=known|NOT SEEN YET)'. p00 is only recovered while enabled, so read it on a SECOND toggle after enabled frames have run.

keys.name: F10 eye, F11/F12 ipd, F7/F8 convergence

bindings.notes: F6 wiggle, F7/F8 convergence, F9 stereo, F11/F12 ipd ALL exercised live 2026-09-07 and all reversible. F10 is refused while wiggle is on (the wiggle owns the eye). F12 is also Steam's screenshot key - harmless, but the toast overlay sits in screen captures for ~10 s and will contaminate image analysis of the bottom-right corner.

bindings.action: walk the character forward (and W/A/S/D generally)
bindings.notes: 12 discrete taps (80 ms hold, 150 ms gap) walked Alice from in front of the Whitechapel arch to under it. A/S/D assumed by symmetry but NOT individually exercised. Camera control still unexercised - it needs mouse injection and the harness is keyboard-only.

steps: wait for the window (fullscreen-exclusive if Fullscreen=True - fix to windowed first, see hazards)
PROFILE SELECT: the profile is highlighted, Enter (this is ENTER=load, not DELETE)
main menu: CONTINUE GAME highlighted, Enter
wait ~30 s for the level load
radial categories: Right to CONTROLS then Down to VIDEO (or navigate to VIDEO), Enter
routes.notes: 3D STEREO is the 4th row; Left/Right toggles it OFF<->ON. Esc raises a 'Cancel? changes lost' dialog (Right=YES to discard).

steps: Esc (pause menu) - it opens with MEMORIES highlighted
Down x3 to MAIN MENU - VERIFY the highlight; RESTART is the row before it
Enter; 'Return to the Main Menu? All unsaved progress will be lost.' Right=yes, VERIFY, Enter
wait ~10 s for the main menu
Down x5 to EXIT GAME - VERIFY (the main menu highlight resets to CONTINUE GAME)
Enter; 'Are you sure you want to quit?' Right=yes, VERIFY, Enter
routes.notes: CORRECTED 2026-09-07: the earlier 'Down x2 to MAIN MENU' was wrong - the pause menu opens on MEMORIES, so Down x2 lands on RESTART. Also, after backing out of any submenu the main menu highlight resets to CONTINUE GAME, so count from the top every time rather than from where you were. Both dialogs default to NO. Quits gracefully; the proxy logs a clean 'unloading'.

entry_points.config_path: MACHINE-DEPENDENT - this game has TWO UE3 config trees and which one is live differs per machine. Dev PC (2026-09-07): Documents\My Games\Alice Madness Returns\AliceGame\Config\AliceEngine.ini is LIVE (the game rewrites it on exit; launching from it came up windowed 1280x720). Home PC (2026-09-05): that tree does not exist and the live file is Documents\My Games\UnrealEngine3\MonkeyGame\Config\MonkeyEngine.ini (UE3 names config after the script package, here 'Monkey'). Do not assume a filename - compare mtimes and let the game tell you by rewriting one on exit.

proxy_hotkeys.notes: The d3d9.dll proxy polls F7-F12 via GetAsyncKeyState each Present; answers in alice_vr_proxy_log.txt. F9 toggle stereo (confirmed live). No in-game developer console investigated.

console.notes: Not investigated. The engine exposes Exec* config identifiers (ExecStereo3D etc.) but reached via the menu, not a typed console, as far as tested.

hazards.notes: Fullscreen=True gives fullscreen-exclusive; BitBlt captures solid black and the game cannot be seen or driven. Set Fullscreen=False in the LIVE config tree while the game is CLOSED (UE3 rewrites config on exit). See entry_points.config_path - WHICH tree is live differs per machine.

hazards.hazard: PROFILE SELECT has a DELETE action
hazards.notes: NEW / ENTER / DELETE on the profile screen. Enter on the highlighted profile loads it (ENTER), but do not stray onto DELETE.

hazards.hazard: The pause menu has RESTART above MAIN MENU
hazards.notes: Order MEMORIES / CONFIGURATION / RESTART / MAIN MENU. Verify the highlight before Enter when heading for MAIN MENU.
Cancel-changes, return-to-main-menu and quit dialogs all start on NO (left); press Right for YES and verify before Enter.

hazards.hazard: The proxy never frees the real d3d9.dll (latent reload-past)
hazards.notes: If the game ever FreeLibrary's the proxy, the system d3d9 stays resident by name and the proxy never reloads. Did NOT bite on 2026-09-04 (proxy resident all session). See dossier section 4.

hazards.hazard: Menu highlight resets to the top after backing out of a submenu
hazards.notes: Esc out of EXTRA CONTENT and the main menu highlight is back on CONTINUE GAME, not where you were. Always re-capture and count from the top; never reuse a Down-count across a submenu visit. This menu has no destructive row, but PROFILE SELECT does.

disproved.claim: The F9 shear test on the 2026-09-03 M0 build gives a clean read of the c0 delivery path
disproved.result: inconclusive: the stats line fires before F9, vp_writes is gated behind g_st.enabled, and the F9 log samples p00 at the toggle instant; the frame diff was scene animation, not a shear
disproved.notes: Not a disproof of c0 delivery - a disproof of the TEST. Use the F9 double-toggle retest or ungate the instrumentation.

disproved.claim: The player character is not receiving the stereo shear (Alice shows ~0 disparity while the world around her doubles)
disproved.result: disproved - she IS sheared. Holding ipd at 12.5 and sweeping convergence moves her disparity a long way: conv 98 -> +78 px, conv 300 -> -1 px, conv 915 -> +26 px. Her near-zero reading at default settings is the third-person camera distance sitting near the convergence plane. The NPCs (also skinned) read +60 px and agree.
disproved.notes: Worth keeping because the anaglyph LOOKS exactly like the 'flat cardboard hero' failure. Judge it with the convergence lever, not by eye.

disproved.claim: draws_fixed in the proxy log reports how many draws received the vertex stereo shear
disproved.result: disproved - it counts PIXEL-shader fix-texture bindings in applyPixelStereo() only, and says nothing about the c0 vertex path. Rate is ~5/frame in gameplay, ~1/frame in menus.
disproved.notes: Use 'wiggle flips' to prove the eye alternated; there is no counter for sheared draws.
